stories.headline: Flávio Bolsonaro edges Lula 47% to 45% in Brazil's first round; runoff Oct 25, markets rally

key_facts.fact: With 100% of sections counted, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) won 56,104,503 votes (47.03%) and President Lula (PT) 53,879,538 (45.16%) in the Oct 4 first round; Augusto Cury (Avante) was third with 2.89%.
key_facts.excerpt: Presidente, com 100,00% das seções totalizadas: FLAVIO BOLSONARO (PL) com 56.104.503 votos, 47,03%; LULA (PT) com 53.879.538 votos, 45,16%; ESCRITOR AUGUSTO CURY (AVANTE) com 3.448.569 votos, 2,89%.

key_facts.fact: Neither candidate passed 50%, so the two will meet in a runoff on October 25.
key_facts.excerpt: But he did not obtain more than 50% of the votes required to win outright. There will be a run-off vote between these two candidates on 25 October.

key_facts.fact: Lula called the result 'unexpected' and said he had been convinced he would win in the first round, but insisted the race was not over.
key_facts.excerpt: Lula admitted the outcome of the vote was "unexpected", but insisted that the race was not over. "I admit I was convinced I would win in the first round," he said on Sunday.

key_facts.fact: Final polls had Lula slightly ahead: Quaest showed 46% of valid votes for Lula vs 45% for Flávio, and Datafolha 45% vs 42%.
key_facts.excerpt: No último sábado, a Quaest apontava 46% dos votos válidos para o petista contra 45% para o senador do PL, e o Datafolha, 45% e 42%, respectivamente.

key_facts.fact: Ibovespa futures jumped 8.43% to 209,280 points at 9:05 a.m. Brasília time on Monday; the Frankfurt-listed MSCI Brazil ETF rose more than 14% before local markets opened.
key_facts.excerpt: Às 9h05 (horário de Brasília), o contrato subia 8,43%, aos 209.280 pontos... O ETF MSCI Brasil, listado na bolsa de Frankfurt, subia mais de 14%

key_facts.fact: The real strengthened more than 4% against the dollar in early trading, moving below 5.00 per dollar from about 5.22, and J.P. Morgan upgraded Brazilian equities to overweight.
key_facts.excerpt: Brazil's real currency strengthened more than 4 per cent against the US dollar in early trading, moving below 5.00 per greenback, from around 5.22 previously... J.P. Morgan upgraded Brazil's equities to "overweight" on Monday

key_facts.fact: On prediction markets, Flávio Bolsonaro's odds of winning rose to over 80% on Kalshi (from about 60%) and 85% on Polymarket (from 63%).
key_facts.excerpt: Speculators on prediction market platform Kalshi now give Bolsonaro a more than 80% chance of winning the presidency. Before Sunday's first round results came in, he had about a 60% chance to win. On Polymarket, Bolsonaro's odds are now 85%, jumping from 63%

stories.headline: Tankers hit in Hormuz, Houthis strike Saudi oil sites as Iran-US talks stall

key_facts.fact: UKMTO reported a crude tanker struck by an unknown projectile four nautical miles east of Oman on Saturday (Oct 3) and another tanker struck Sunday (Oct 4) in the Strait of Hormuz, damaging its engine room.
key_facts.excerpt: On Saturday, the UKMTO... received a report of a crude oil tanker being hit by an unknown projectile four nautical miles east of Oman. It said another tanker was reported as being similarly struck Sunday in the Strait of Hormuz, causing damage to its engine room.

key_facts.fact: The Sunday strike was the fourth on a commercial tanker in the strait since the start of October, all on the Omani side, per UKMTO.
key_facts.excerpt: The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations reported yet another strike on a commercial tanker in the Strait of Hormuz on Sunday, the fourth since the start of October. All of the strikes have occurred on the Omani side of the waterway

key_facts.fact: Iran-aligned Houthis said they fired ballistic missiles and drones at oil facilities in Riyadh and the Khurais oil field, an escalation of a second front in the Iran war.
key_facts.excerpt: Houthi military spokesperson Yahya Saree said the strikes successfully damaged sites in Riyadh and the Khurais oil field, which sits just east of the city.

key_facts.fact: Iranian parliament speaker Ghalibaf said Hormuz will not reopen until Iran's seven conditions based on the Islamabad Memorandum are met; FM Araghchi said there is 'no military solution'.
key_facts.excerpt: Iran's top diplomat insisted on Sunday that there would be no military solution to the United States' war against the Islamic republic, with talks on ending the conflict apparently at an impasse.

key_facts.fact: Trump said on Oct 3 he was approaching a decision on Iran, the 'easy way or the hard way'; Treasury Secretary Bessent said Iran would have no oil cargoes at sea this week.
key_facts.excerpt: "We have a decision that I'll make about Iran," Trump told reporters. "Iran has been decimated, so the only question is it'll either be the easy way or the hard way."... Bessent said Iran would have no oil shipments at sea this week

key_facts.fact: The US withdrew about a dozen B-1 bombers from RAF Fairford in the UK, citing concerns about potential attacks after a foiled plot near the base; Tehran denied any link.
key_facts.excerpt: Days later, the United States speedily sent B-1 bombers stationed there, which were used to strike Iran in its ongoing war, back home. About a dozen had been stationed at the air base... Tehran has denied any link to the alleged plot to target the base.

stories.headline: Russia vows to intensify Kyiv strikes as Merz brings €1.3B aid and Zelensky backs October talks

key_facts.fact: Russia's Defence Ministry said on Oct 4 it will intensify strikes on Kyiv and elsewhere in Ukraine, responding to Zelensky's vow to step up attacks on Russian oil refineries.
key_facts.excerpt: Russia will intensify strikes on Kyiv and other parts of Ukraine, the Russian Defence Ministry said on Sunday, responding to an interview with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy in which he vowed increased attacks on Russian refineries.

key_facts.fact: Zelensky said Russia used more than 1,900 attack drones (over 800 jet-powered), 1,700 aerial bombs and 25 missiles in the past week; Kyiv's Northern Bridge was hit for a fourth straight day of bridge strikes.
key_facts.excerpt: "Just this week, Russia has used more than 1,900 attack drones, 1,700 aerial bombs, and 25 missiles against Ukraine. More than 800 of the drones were jet-powered."

key_facts.fact: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz announced in Kyiv a package of more than €1.3 billion ($1.46 billion): €1 billion in military aid including interceptor-drone production and thousands of IRIS-T missiles, plus about €350 million in energy assistance.
key_facts.excerpt: The package includes €1 billion ($1.13 billion) in military aid, including financing the production of interceptor drones... "thousands" of missiles for the German-made IRIS-T air defense systems... around €350 million ($394 million) in energy assistance

key_facts.fact: Germany will finance Quantum Systems to produce tens of thousands of interceptors in Ukraine to counter Russia's jet-powered drones.
key_facts.excerpt: The European drone manufacturer Quantum Systems will receive financing from Germany to produce tens of thousands of interceptors in Ukraine.

key_facts.fact: Zelensky said Ukraine is ready for trilateral talks with the US and Russia this month, possibly in the UAE, with Washington pushing for technical-level talks by end-October.
key_facts.excerpt: Washington is now pushing for technical-level talks by the end of October, Zelenskyy said. He confirmed earlier reports that the United Arab Emirates, which has hosted previous talks, could again be the setting for a meeting.

key_facts.fact: Ukraine's SBU said its drones hit a Su-35 and a Su-34 plus an ammunition depot at Khanskaya airfield in Russia's Adygea, about 500 km from Ukrainian territory.
key_facts.excerpt: Drones operated by the SBU's Alpha special operations unit hit a Su-35 multirole fighter jet and a Su-34 fighter-bomber at the airfield, located around 500 kilometers (310 miles) from Ukrainian territory.

stories.headline: G7 orders 100M-barrel oil and diesel release; OPEC+ holds November output with Brent above $100

key_facts.fact: G7 leaders agreed on Oct 2 to a coordinated IEA release of 100 million barrels of crude and diesel, starting immediately over four months, with a frontloaded diesel release in the first 20 days.
key_facts.excerpt: we will implement our commitments with a coordinated release through the IEA of 100 million barrels (MB) to begin immediately over 4 months, including a frontloaded substantial diesel release within the first 20 days by G7 members and partners.

key_facts.fact: G7 members pledged not to impose energy export restrictions among themselves, after Trump had threatened a US diesel export ban.
key_facts.excerpt: Under the measures, which come after US President Donald Trump had threatened to ban diesel exports, there will not be any "export restrictions on energy and energy products" between G7 members.

key_facts.fact: The Iran war already prompted a record 400-million-barrel IEA release in March, about two-thirds of which had been delivered.
key_facts.excerpt: The Iran war sparked the biggest emergency stock release ever of 400 million barrels in March... IEA Executive Director Fatih Birol said this week that members had released about two-thirds of the 400-million-barrel agreement

key_facts.fact: Seven OPEC+ countries (Saudi Arabia, Russia, Iraq, Kuwait, Kazakhstan, Algeria, Oman) met virtually on Oct 4 and kept November required production at September levels; next meeting Nov 1.
key_facts.excerpt: The seven participating countries decided to maintain September 2026 required production for November 2026... The next meeting will be held on 1 November 2026.

key_facts.fact: November required production is 10.478 million bpd for Saudi Arabia and 9.949 million bpd for Russia.
key_facts.excerpt: November's "required production" is 10.478 million barrels per day for Saudi Arabia, 9.949 million barrels per day for Russia, 4.431 million barrels per day for Iraq

key_facts.fact: It is the second straight month without an output increase; Brent settled at $102.25 on Friday, up from about $73 before the Feb. 28 attack on Iran.
key_facts.excerpt: OPEC+ also held targets in October, making November a second straight month without an increase. Brent crude settled at $102.25 a barrel Friday and traded near $102 in Asia on Monday, up from about $73 before the US and Israel attacked Iran on February 28.

stories.headline: Shionogi buys rare-disease biotech IntraBio for $2B; GE HealthCare buys Sofie for $945M

key_facts.fact: Shionogi's board approved on Oct 5 an agreement for its US unit to acquire all of Austin-based IntraBio for $2.0 billion upfront, adding the rare-disease drug Aqneursa (levacetylleucine).
key_facts.excerpt: Under the terms of the agreement, Shionogi Inc. will acquire all outstanding shares of IntraBio for an upfront consideration of USD 2.0 billion payable to IntraBio shareholders.

key_facts.fact: Closing is planned for November-December 2026, subject to competition-law waiting periods and regulatory clearances.
key_facts.excerpt: Transaction Execution Date: Scheduled between November 2026 and December 2026 (planned)

key_facts.fact: Aqneursa on Sept 18 became the first FDA-approved drug for ataxia in ataxia-telangiectasia; IntraBio had 2025 net sales of $67.9 million, so the price is more than 29x 2025 sales.
key_facts.excerpt: Aqneursa, which on September 18 became the first drug the FDA approved for ataxia in patients with ataxia-telangiectasia... IntraBio 2025 net sales $67.9M (2024: $3.5M), operating loss $35.3M; price is more than 29x 2025 sales.

key_facts.fact: The deal follows Shionogi's $2.5 billion purchase of ALS drug Radicava in April as it builds a rare-disease unit beyond anti-infectives.
key_facts.excerpt: The purchase comes only a few months after Shionogi paid $2.5 billion for Radicava, which it projected would bring in $700 million in annual sales.

key_facts.fact: GE HealthCare said Monday it will buy privately held Sofie Biosciences, owned by Trilantic, for $945 million in cash to strengthen its radiopharmaceutical (PET imaging drug) business; closing expected in H1 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: Medical device maker GE HealthCare said on Monday it would buy privately held Sofie Biosciences for $945 million in cash, in a move that strengthens its ability to manufacture and distribute PET imaging drugs.

key_facts.fact: Sofie helps produce Lantheus' Pylarify for prostate cancer imaging and Neuraceq for Alzheimer's amyloid imaging, and will keep serving existing customers.
key_facts.excerpt: Sofie also helps produce Lantheus' Pylarify (piflufolastat F-18) for prostate cancer imaging and Neuraceq (florabetaben F-18) for beta amyloid plaques and Alzheimer's disease, among others.

stories.headline: Schneider Electric agrees to buy industrial software maker PTC for $23.7B, its largest deal

key_facts.fact: Schneider Electric and PTC announced on Oct 5 a definitive agreement for an all-cash acquisition at $205 per share, valuing PTC's equity at about $22.6 billion and its enterprise value at $23.7 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: All-cash acquisition at $205 per share for 100% of the share capital of PTC, valuing PTC's equity at approximately $22.6 billion (€20.1 billion). Implied Enterprise Value of $23.7 billion (€21.1 billion)

key_facts.fact: The price is a 42.3% premium to PTC's last close and 46.1% to its 30-day volume-weighted average.
key_facts.excerpt: representing a 42.3% premium to PTC's last closing price and a 46.1% premium to the previous 30-trading days volume-weighted average share price prior to announcement.

key_facts.fact: Schneider has a committed $25 billion bridge facility and plans to fund the deal with about €5-6 billion in equity and €16-17 billion in new debt; closing expected by Q3 2027, requiring HSR and CFIUS approval.
key_facts.excerpt: Schneider Electric has a committed $25 billion bridge facility and expects funding to combine an equity issuance of approximately €5 billion to €6 billion and new debt issuance of approximately €16 billion to €17 billion.

key_facts.fact: PTC would owe Schneider a $700 million termination fee in specified circumstances such as accepting a superior offer.
key_facts.excerpt: PTC may owe Schneider Electric a $700 million termination fee in specified circumstances, including PTC's termination to accept a Superior Offer

key_facts.fact: It is Schneider's biggest deal ever, as the French group builds up its data centre business amid booming demand.
key_facts.excerpt: France's Schneider Electric struck its biggest deal ever on Monday, agreeing to buy US software company PTC for around $22.6 billion as it builds up its data centre business amid booming demand.

stories.headline: OKX-ICE venture notifies SEC it will run a 24/7 tokenized-stock venue for 63 US shares

key_facts.fact: OKXICE, the 50/50 joint venture of OKX and NYSE owner Intercontinental Exchange, published a notice dated Oct 4 that it intends to operate a Tokenized Securities Venue under the SEC's new exemption.
key_facts.excerpt: OKXICE TSV is operated by OKXICE LLC... a joint venture between Intercontinental Exchange Holdings, Inc. ("ICE") and OKC USA Holding Inc. ("OKC USA"). OKXICE LLC is 50% owned by ICE and 50% owned by OKC USA.

key_facts.fact: The list of 63 tokenized stocks includes Nvidia, Tesla, Apple, Microsoft, SpaceX, JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs and Walmart, each paired with the USDC, USDG or USDT stablecoins.
key_facts.excerpt: The public notice, dated October 4, lists 63 symbols from U.S. exchanges, and each token would trade against USDC, USDG or USDT.

key_facts.fact: Trading would run around the clock via permissioned Uniswap v4 pools on OKX's X Layer blockchain rather than an order book; no launch date was given.
key_facts.excerpt: OKXICE will not run an order book or hold client assets. Participants would trade from their own wallets against Uniswap v4 pools on the XLayer blockchain... Fees will be published separately, and it gave no launch date.

key_facts.fact: The SEC exemption caps venues at 75 symbols for the most liquid stocks and 0.25% of each stock's prior-month average daily volume, and runs for five years.
key_facts.excerpt: For the most liquid stocks, a venue may list at most 75 symbols and trade no more than 0.25% of each stock's average daily volume in the prior month, the notice says... The exemption runs for five years.

key_facts.fact: Issuers get a 30-day window to object when a third party tokenizes their shares; chipmaker Cerebras has already lodged an objection.
key_facts.excerpt: Chipmaker Cerebras Systems has already lodged an objection with the venue, which does not name the firm issuing its tokens.
